env.label: shared CI VM - noisy, for relative comparison
env.build: CMake Release, cmake version 4.5.0, GitHub-hosted Windows runner (win25-vs2026 20261116.315.1)
env.build_facts: msvc-release-crt, NDEBUG, stdio: UCRT, tblog: static library

config.process_per_run: every measured run is a fresh process (Quill's backend starts once per process)
config.e2e_definition: start until every line is written and the file closed and fsynced: tblog_shutdown; spdlog / Quill: flush + shutdown, then reopen + fsync

variants.tblog_block: TBLOG_INFO, default config except file only (console=false, reload.watch=false, file.max_size=4GB), full_policy=block
variants.spdlog_async: spdlog 1.17.0 async_logger: thread pool queue 8192, 1 thread, overflow block (defaults); basic_file_sink
variants.quill: Quill 13.1.0: default FrontendOptions (UnboundedBlocking, 128 KiB initial) and BackendOptions except error_notifier = {}; FileSink
